user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hello, I’m having trouble sending picture messages—those MMS things—from my phone. It’s been a few hours now and I just can’t get them to go through. Can you help me fix this?

To assist you with the MMS issue, I need to identify your account first. Could you please provide me with your phone number or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check the relevant settings.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you also need my date of birth, or is that enough?
For verification and accurate lookup, I need your full name along with your date of birth. Could you please provide your date of birth as well?
Of course, my date of birth is March 14, 1960. Let me know if you need anything else to check my account.

I found an account under the name John Smith with the phone number 555-123-2002, but the date of birth on file is June 15, 1985, which does not match the date you provided. Could you please confirm if this is your account or provide any other details to help me verify?

Oh dear, that’s strange. I’m sure my number is 555-123-2002 and my name is John Smith. I might have made a mistake with the date—technology always confuses me. Could you maybe check again with just my name and number? Or is there another way I can verify it?

Since the date of birth is required for verification and to ensure your account's security, I cannot proceed with the lookup without it. If you can provide the correct date of birth, I will be able to assist you further with your MMS issue.

I understand, but I’m really sure about my date of birth—it’s March 14, 1960. Is there any other way I can prove it’s my account? Maybe by answering some security questions or something else? I just want to get these picture messages working again.

I understand your concern. However, for security and privacy reasons, I can only verify your account using the full name and date of birth combination as per policy. If the date of birth you provided does not match our records, I am unable to access your account details.

If you want, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to assist you further with alternative verification methods. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, please transfer me to a human agent. I really need help with this, and maybe they can sort out the verification for me. Thank you.
